source: AgERA5 daily maximum and minimum 2 m temperature
latency_note: the newest day shown is two days behind the newest input day

trend.rule: Theil-Sen slope; Mann-Kendall p, plain and after removing lag-1 autocorrelation, both must pass the Benjamini-Hochberg threshold; blocks north of 60 S
trend.caveat: The source is a reanalysis whose inputs change over the years, which can add or hide a trend, and the yardstick is fixed on 1991 to 2020 and not adjusted for warming.

season.note: project definition from the last 12 weekly layers; not part of frozen version 1.0, not tested on events

humid.caution: Humid heat here is judged against 1991 to 2020. The humidity record in the source data drifts, so recent years are flagged far more often than the past for reasons that are partly not climate.
humid.note: yes or no only; never part of a headline number, rank, trend or status; own confidence mask in static/mask_humid.png; see pipeline/run_humid.py

daynight.note: project definition, not part of frozen version 1.0, not tested on events; see pipeline/run_daynight.py

settings.event_size: degree-days above the heat threshold, area mean, summed over the event (setting, not frozen)
settings.cell_floor_note: set 2026-11-22; units below it have no area shares; at 9 cells a share moves in steps of about 11 percent
settings.confidence_note: provisional limits on the sd of AgERA5 daily mean temperature anomalies
